# 中国人投资美股指南

一份写给中国大陆投资者的美股科普，从开户、税务、合规，一直讲到选券商、入金和出金，尽量把每一步的来龙去脉和背后的风险讲清楚。

*本系列只是个人科普，不构成任何投资、税务或法律建议。这块的政策变得很快，文中不少信息可能已经过时，动手前请自己再核实一遍。*

*正篇最后校订于 2026 年 5 月，之后的变化以加更为准。*

## 目录

| # | 篇章 | 内容简介 |
|---|------|----------|
| 一 | [开户](01-美股指南（一）开户.md) | 总览：银行账户和券商账户分别怎么开 |
| 二 | [税务](02-美股指南（二）税务.md) | CRS、FATCA 机制与税务系统的"三层视野" |
| 三 | [合规](03-美股指南（三）合规.md) | 按风险接受度分低、中、高三类的投资路径 |
| 四 | [美国券商](04-美股指南（四）美国券商.md) | 券商怎么分层、受谁监管、怎么挑 |
| 五 | [银行入金](05-美股指南（五）银行入金.md) | 港、美银行远程开户与汇款入金 |
| 六 | [加密入金](06-美股指南（六）加密入金.md) | 加密货币入金的进阶玩法（小众） |
| 七 | [出金](07-美股指南（七）出金.md) | 终身持有、消费、汇回、加密等出金路径 |
| 八 | [美国税号](08-美股指南（八）美国税号.md) | ITIN 怎么申请、办下来后能多开哪些户 |
| 九 | [总结](09-美股指南（九）总结.md) | 三条路线的取舍与给普通人的最终建议 |

## 加更

正篇之后的政策与渠道变化，单独追更在这里：

| 日期 | 内容简介 |
|------|----------|
| 2026/06/05 | [Fiat24 关停、境外投资新规与各渠道近况](10-2026.06.05-政策变化.md) |
| 2026/06/15 | [加密合规 CARF 与中国居民的税务盲区](11-2026.06.15-加密合规CARF.md) |
| 2026/06/21 | [不丹 BIT 的隐蔽入金路径](12-2026.06.21-美国之外的非CRS券商.md) |

## 阅读建议

九篇大致按"先搞懂规则、再把钱投进去、最后安全取回来"的顺序展开，也可以挑着看：

- 新手建议先看完 **二（税务）** 和 **三（合规）**。搞清楚国家怎么征税、自己能接受多大风险，比急着开户重要得多。
- 想动手开户，看 **一（开户）**、**四（美国券商）** 和 **五（银行入金）**，传统的"银行转券商"这条路就走通了。
- 嫌能开的户太少，可以读 **八（美国税号）**。有些银行和券商本来就对中国人开放，办下 ITIN 之后能开的更多。
- 传统渠道走不通，再考虑 **六（加密入金）**。这是进阶方案，理解门槛和合规风险都偏高，多数人用不上。
- 准备把钱拿回来，看 **七（出金）**，重点是遗产税和各条出金路径的合规风险。
- 只想看结论，直接翻 **九（总结）**。
- 已经读过正篇，只想跟进政策和渠道的最新变化，看 **加更**。

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive guide for mainland Chinese investors on how to open accounts and trade US stocks.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides a step-by-step educational guide tailored for investors in mainland China who want to participate in the US stock market. It covers the entire lifecycle of investing, from opening offshore bank accounts to selecting the right brokerage. The guide explains the complex legal and tax implications involved in cross-border investing. It aims to clarify the risks and procedures, ensuring investors understand the mechanics of funding and withdrawing capital safely.
keyFeatures: Account opening: detailed steps for setting up both bank and brokerage accounts.
Tax implications: explains the specific tax rules applying to Chinese citizens trading US stocks.
Compliance advice: highlights legal risks and regulatory requirements.
Brokerage selection: compares different platforms suitable for mainland investors.
Funding mechanics: guides users through the process of depositing and withdrawing funds.

useCases.title: First-time offshore investing
useCases.description: Helps beginners navigate the complex process of opening their first US stock account from China.

useCases.title: Understanding tax liabilities
useCases.description: Allows investors to plan their trades while being aware of potential tax obligations.

useCases.title: Choosing a broker
useCases.description: Assists users in comparing brokerages based on fees, accessibility, and reliability.

useCases.title: Safe fund transfers
useCases.description: Provides instructions on how to legally and securely move money across borders.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This guide is for individual investors based in mainland China who are looking to diversify their portfolios by investing in US equities, but lack the knowledge of how to start.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Read the `01-美股指南（一）开户.md` file to learn about opening bank and brokerage accounts.
